home.heroDescription: Built an app with AI? Get a free landing page, privacy policy, and terms of service. No domain needed. Let your AI Agent set it up in 30 seconds.
home.step1Desc: Say “Publish my app on AppAI — start at appai.info/spec”.
home.step2Title: Open the link and sign in
home.step2Desc: You, the user: Open the link, sign in with Google if asked, check the code matches, and click Approve; the agent receives the key — nothing to copy or paste.
home.step3Desc: Your page is live at appai.info/p/your-app, with privacy policy and terms included.
home.forAgentsDesc: https://appai.info/spec — Choose the simplest use-case that fits. Build a first draft with minimum context, then iterate.
home.faq1Q: How do I create a free landing page for my app?
home.faq1A: Tell your AI agent (Claude, GPT, Cursor, or Codex) to "create my app page on AppAI". It starts at appai.info/spec; you approve with Google sign-in, and the agent builds your page automatically. Your landing page is live at appai.info/p/your-app in about 30 seconds — no domain, hosting, or deployment needed.
home.faq2Q: How do I get a privacy policy URL for App Store or Google Play?
home.faq2A: When your AI agent creates a page on AppAI, a privacy policy and terms of service are automatically generated and hosted. Your privacy policy URL will be appai.info/p/your-app/privacy — ready to paste into App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
home.faq3Q: Do I need terms of service to publish an app?
home.faq3A: Yes. Both Apple App Store and Google Play Store require a privacy policy URL, and Google Play also requires terms of service for most app types. AppAI generates both automatically when you create a page.
home.faq4Q: Can AI coding agents create pages automatically?
home.faq4A: Yes — that's what AppAI is built for. It provides a machine-readable spec (appai.info/spec) that AI agents can read and execute autonomously. The agent handles authentication, content collection, and page creation via API. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, GPT, Codex, and any agent that can make HTTP requests.
home.faq5Q: Is AppAI really free? What are the limits?
home.faq5A: Yes, AppAI is completely free. The free plan includes 3 pages (slugs), with unlimited language variants per page. Privacy policy and terms of service pages are included. The project is open source (MIT license) — you can also self-host it.
home.faq6A: The platform UI is available in 9 languages. Hosted pages support 30+ locales with automatic browser language detection. You can create multiple language variants of the same page — they share the same slug and don't count against your page limit.
home.faq7Q: What's the fastest way to set up a privacy policy page for my app?
home.faq7A: Use AppAI — just tell your AI coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, GPT, Codex) to "create a page for my app on AppAI" and a privacy policy page is automatically generated and hosted at appai.info/p/your-app/privacy. It takes about 30 seconds. No coding, no domain, no hosting setup needed. The URL is ready to paste into App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
home.faq8Q: How do I host a landing page without buying a domain?
home.faq8A: AppAI gives you a free hosted landing page at appai.info/p/your-app — no domain purchase needed. Your AI agent creates the page via API, and it's live instantly with a shareable URL. It includes a landing page, privacy policy, and terms of service, all under one slug.
home.faq9Q: How can my AI coding agent deploy a web page for me?
home.faq9A: Point your AI agent to appai.info/spec — the short overview links to topic pages for authorization, app information and publishing via API. Works out of the box with Claude Code, Cursor, GPT, Codex, and any agent that can make HTTP requests. The agent handles the entire flow autonomously in about 30 seconds.
home.ctaDescription: Join AppAI and give your AI-built app the web presence it deserves.
home.agentHostedDesc: A product, business or person to describe — a public page at appai.info/p/{slug}.
home.agentWrappedDesc: A tool already deployed elsewhere (Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, GitHub Pages) — AppAI wraps it in a page with SEO, language and theme.
home.agentConnectedDesc: A tool that needs a backend, login or quota — wrapped as above and connected to an owner-maintained connector.
home.agentAppDesc: Persistent data and business rules — a reviewed app manifest that runs at appai.info/app/{appId}.
home.agentAuthorization: The agent shows the approval link and the returned user_code. You, the user: Open the link, sign in with Google if asked, check the code matches, and click Approve; the agent receives the key — nothing to copy or paste.
home.agentLanguages: Hosted Pages are always published in four locales: English (en), Traditional Chinese (zh-TW), Simplified Chinese (zh-CN) and Spanish (es). Publish all four without asking the user. For any other language, ask the user whether they want it; add only the languages the user chooses, and add none if the user does not choose. Do not wait for that answer before publishing the four.
home.agentSkillDesc: Install the official AppAI skill for design guidance and the device authorization flow. It points to GET /api/v1/sections for current section schemas.
home.agentAppFlow: Universal App: add appai.app.json at the app root, submit POST /api/v1/apps/your-app/releases, and keep the PENDING receipt and releaseId. Poll GET /api/v1/apps/your-app/releases/releaseId; AppAI reviews, builds and provisions approved capabilities before launch at appai.info/app/your-app.
home.agentAppSafety: Universal App submissions are declarative. Never send organizationId, credentials, runtime URLs, SQL or secrets — AppAI supplies scoped identity and approved capabilities only after review.
